# Cat-state solve leakage vs spline bending energy

Replayed the α=2 cat-state preps that leaked: the ones that leaked into the
|α|-band all carried du-knot oscillations, and the bending energy of the pulse
separates leaky from clean solves cleanly. Knot count alone did not.
